entries.desc: koala artifact_declare with valid path + reason + relatedIntent writes .koala/story/actives/B-cf60/declared-artifacts.json entry and prints success line containing the path
artifact_declare with the same path twice updates the entry (idempotent), not duplicate; second call output mentions overwrite
artifact_declare rejects path with * / ** / leading slash / .. components — runtime check throws explicit error (preMortem #1 anchor)
After artifact_declare, classifyDirtyWorktree routes the declared path to declared_artifact_changes group (verified via koala session_brief output AND koala validate output)
DirtyWorktreeClassifierOptions.declaredArtifactPaths is populated from per-story declared-artifacts.json via store read; classifier consumers receive the merged list
An undeclared sibling path (e.g., tests/output/other.json) in the same worktree remains in unexpected_dirty_files — declaration is exact-match only
When no declaration exists, declared_artifact_changes group remains empty and undeclared paths land in unexpected_dirty_files (B-6326 conservative default preserved)

Declared artifact does NOT remove the path from material verification — if the artifact has materialHash drift in a referenced verificationEvidence, freshness check still flags it stale (preMortem #3 anchor)
DONE pre-check passes when every declared artifact has a matching intentRef in verificationEvidence (the relatedIntent recorded at declare time) OR a matching promiseId in delivery-check.docsPromises
DONE pre-check fails with [unreferenced_declared_artifact] blocker when at least one declared artifact has no matching reference
Reference check validates the intentRef ACTUALLY EXISTS in checklist.items[*].verificationIntent[lane][index] — bogus intentRef like X-001:happy:0 does NOT pass the check (preMortem #2 anchor)
Empty declared-artifacts.json (no entries) does NOT trigger the gate — gate only fires when there is at least one entry
Smoke: declare tests/output/bl21_lacz_ecoli_minicell/prodenovo_viewer.json with relatedIntent CHK-001:happy:0; classifyDirtyWorktree categorizes it as declared_artifact_changes
Smoke: same path WITHOUT declaration → classifyDirtyWorktree categorizes it as unexpected_dirty_files (B-6326 default behavior preserved)
Smoke: declared path + matching verificationEvidence entry → DONE pre-check declared-artifacts row passes
Smoke: declared path + NO matching evidence → DONE pre-check row fails with [unreferenced_declared_artifact] blocker
Smoke: artifact_declare with malicious path (containing * or ..) throws — preMortem #1 path-broadening defense
Smoke: declared+unreferenced + declared+referenced coexist; DONE gate fails (1 unreferenced is enough to block)
